daily_narrative.happened: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq each rose 0.4% even as VIX climbed 5%, suggesting a choppy risk-on session led by materials and health care while Marvell weighed on tech and utilities lagged. The move appears to reflect reflation-style rotation, with value and quality outperforming momentum and small caps beating large caps, consistent with stronger cyclicals and commodity-sensitive names like FCX, CNH, and CF.
